QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `include/mbedtls/platform.h` (around line 164) does `#define mbedtls_calloc calloc` and `#define mbedtls_free free`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that by default (without MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY) mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros expanding directly to calloc and free.
